title: Practice 2: Moving in, out and up

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **вхожу** — входи́ть (imperfective): to enter, to go in(to) (by foot), to get in(to); to penetrate into; to be a part of / to be included. Wiktionary: в- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does в- add in ворва́ться (“to rush into, to burst, to enter by force, violently or hurriedly, to intrude”)?
options: the manner of an action, given by the base word
giving or acquiring a status or state
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists ворва́ться under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in врыва́ться (“to rush into, to burst, to enter by force, to enter violently or hurriedly, to intrude”)?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists врыва́ться under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).
**вышла** — вы́йти (perfective): to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published; to spend, to be used up; to come off, to come out. Wiktionary: вы́- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **выйти** — вы́йти (perfective): to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published; to spend, to be used up; to come off, to come out. Wiktionary: вы́- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **выбежал** — вы́бежать (perfective): to run out (outside). Wiktionary: вы́- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I ran out of the house.
exercises.why: **выбежал** — вы́бежать (perfective): to run out (outside). Wiktionary: вы́- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does вз- add in взойти́ (“to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend”)?
options: alternative form of вз- (used before voiceless consonants)
alternative form of вз- (used before certain consonant clusters)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists взойти́ under this meaning of вз-. Source: Wiktionary, «вз-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/вз-#Russian).
**взошёл** — взойти́ (perfective): to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body); to come up, to sprout (of a plant); (archaic) to come in, to enter. Wiktionary: взо- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **взошло** — взойти́ (perfective): to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body); to come up, to sprout (of a plant); (archaic) to come in, to enter. Wiktionary: взо- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does вз- add in вски́нуть (“to throw up, to toss up”)?
options: alternative form of вз- (used before certain consonant clusters)
alternative form of вз- (used before voiceless consonants)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists вски́нуть under this meaning of вз-. Source: Wiktionary, «вз-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/вз-#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to rush into, to burst, to enter by force, to enter violently or hurriedly, to intrude
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: врыва́ться — to rush into, to burst, to enter by force, to enter violently or hurriedly, to intrude; вы́йти — to exit, to go out; вы́бежать — to run out (outside); вы́браться — to get out.
